verdict.line: You lose if you let him freely poke with Parrrley stacks before level 6; you win any all-in once Riposte eats his E or an auto.

brief.thesis: Gangplank has no hard CC and no gap-closer beyond his basic attack range, so his entire kit is poke-and-kite via Q (Parrrley) while Fiora's whole kit is built to force and win extended trades. The matchup is close on paper (50.4% over 2452 games) because the fight is really decided by whether Fiora can close the gap before his Q stacks pile up, not by any single ability interaction.

theirWindow.what: He can poke you for free with 5s cooldown Parrrley while staying outside your 600-range Q (Lunge). Don't walk up to last-hit into an open Parrrley; eat it on a minion when you can.

yourWindow.when: he auto-attacks or uses E (Raise Morale) point-blank
yourWindow.what: Pop W (Riposte) the instant he's forced to auto you in melee range or fires off E while adjacent; the parry negates the hit and reflects magic damage, swinging the trade hard in your favor.

start.why: 51.2% win rate over 2150 games (75.7% pick) — the sustained-damage and lifesteal from Doran's Blade helps you win the all-ins you force once you close distance, which is the entire win condition here.

boots.why: 49.8% win rate over 2069 games (81.5% pick) — the flat damage reduction blunts his auto-attack poke and Parrrley chip damage better than Mercury's Treads does here, since he has no hard CC to cleanse.

core.why: Core first item in 57.5% of 574 games — the sustain and cleave let you win extended trades and shove waves to deny his poke angles.
Builds into the 57.5%-winrate path; the move speed and burst proc help you close the gap on a kiting Q-poke champion.
Caps the top build path; the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his poison passive stacks during prolonged skirmishes.

situational.when: he's building tanky and you need the shield to survive his poke before you can engage
you're snowballing and want more sustained siege damage against his Remove Scurvy heal
you want faster cooldown uptime on Q (Lunge) and W (Riposte) to punish his melee windows more often

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing consecutive hits once you close distance, which is exactly the problem this matchup presents — getting in range and staying there.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 89.3% of games at 50.5% win rate — Flash closes the gap on a kiting Parrrley poke, and Ignite punishes his Remove Scurvy heal when you finally land the all-in.

playing.title: Hold W for his melee range
playing.detail: W (Riposte) has a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown and only parries the next basic attack — save it for when he's forced into melee range on an auto or his E (Raise Morale), not to block Parrrley from range.

playing.title: Eat Parrrley on minions
playing.detail: Since you can't block his Q (Parrrley) with Riposte at range, position to let it hit a minion instead of you whenever possible before level 6.

playing.title: Double-tap your Lunge
playing.detail: Q (Lunge) can be cast twice within a couple seconds at no mana cost — use the second cast to close the final gap after he tries to kite away post-trade.

playing.title: All-in through his Remove Scurvy
playing.detail: W (Remove Scurvy) clears CC and heals him but is on 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown — bait it out early in a skirmish, then commit your real all-in once it's down.

playing.title: Track Cannon Barrage for roams
playing.detail: R (Cannon Barrage) has global range and a 120/115/110/120/120s cooldown; once he hits 6, expect him to zone you off objectives with it rather than fight you directly.

playing.title: Use E for the kill-refresh loop
playing.detail: E (Burst of Speed) refreshes its cooldown if you kill a champion — chain it into every all-in attempt so you keep attack speed and move speed for the follow-up fight.

playing.title: Shove waves to deny poke angles
playing.detail: A pushed wave limits the distance he has to kite and Parrrley you from, forcing him into the melee range where your Riposte and Lunge punish him.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Block Gangplank’s (E) or (P)-basic attack with [W] to gain the upper hand in combat. Be careful of being poked at by his barrels.
